description: Index of the ADSB.lol globe_history release volumes (planes-readsb prod-0, or staging-0 where no prod-0 release exists for a day) that were cropped for this solution: one entry per volume with release date, file name, download URL, size in bytes, source digest published by GitHub (null where the release carries none) and the SHA-256 of the file we downloaded. Read by download_adsb.py as manifest.json; set root to the absolute path of the download directory before running.
